# 00000000968

**OA-68 △** — source: 25_算子代数与泛函分析.md

**English.** Definition: The q-Gaussian algebra Γ_q(H) is generated by q-commutation relations. Conjecture: As q → 1, the divergence rate of the difference between the free entropy dimension δ₀ of Γ_q(H) and the free-algebra value is −(dim H)·log(1−q)·(1+o(1)), with coefficient exactly the number of generators; the divergence rate follows directly from the microstate-dimension lower bound of the q-semicircle.

**中文。** 定义：q-Gaussian 代数 Γ_q(H) 由 q-交换关系生成。猜想：q→1 时 Γ_q(H) 的自由熵维数 δ₀ 与自由代数对应值之差的发散率为 −(dim H)·log(1−q)·(1+o(1)),系数恰为生成元个数;该发散率由 q-半圆的微态维数下界直接给出。
